basic_details.job_title: APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Army Public School, Barrackpore (North Gate, Barrackpore Cantonment, Kolkata – 700120) is inviting applications for the post of Administrative Officer on a contractual appointment for three years. The post is open only to a civilian lady or a retired/released woman officer up to 55 years of age. Applications must be submitted on plain paper, with photocopies of mark sheets and certificates and one recent passport-size photograph, by 05 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About APS Barrackpore
content_sections.text: Army Public School, Barrackpore is a school located at North Gate, Barrackpore Cantonment, Kolkata – 700120. The vacancy notice for the Administrative Officer post is issued under the name of the school's Chairman.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application has to be written on plain paper; the notice does not prescribe any application form. Attach photocopies of your mark sheets and certificates and one recent passport-size photograph, and submit the application by 05 December 2026. The notice prints the school's address as North Gate, Barrackpore Cantonment, Kolkata – 700120, but it does not state the address to which the application must be sent or the mode of submission (post, courier or by hand). It also does not say whether 05 December 2026 is the date of receipt or of dispatch. Application on plain paper Photocopies of mark sheets Photocopies of certificates One recent passport-size photograph

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The vacancy is for one designation, Administrative Officer. The notice sets out these requirements: Civilian lady or retired/released woman officer. Age: up to 55 years of age. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Graduate from a recognized university. Preference will be given to candidates with qualifications in Commerce, MBA, or Law. Minimum 5 years of experience in administration, preferably in an academic institution. Ability and willingness to engage in liaison work with various Government and Non-Government organizations. Proficiency in computer operations and accounting. Strong communication skills in English and Hindi. Familiarity with government rules and regulations, procurement procedures, and legal matters, including labour laws. Salary: negotiable based on qualifications and experience. The notice does not print a pay amount or pay level. Terms of appointment: contractual appointment for a term of three years. Candidates should check the full eligibility conditions for the post in the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Applications for the Administrative Officer post at Army Public School, Barrackpore must be submitted by 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer vacancy?
faq.answer: Only a civilian lady or a retired/released woman officer up to 55 years of age can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university, and preference will be given to those with qualifications in Commerce, MBA, or Law.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required for the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of experience in administration is required, preferably in an academic institution, along with the ability and willingness to do liaison work with Government and Non-Government organizations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 55 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The salary is negotiable based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Submit an application on plain paper along with photocopies of mark sheets and certificates and one recent passport-size photograph by 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual appointment for a term of three years.

faq.question: Q9. Which skills are required for the APS Barrackpore Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need proficiency in computer operations and accounting and strong communication skills in English and Hindi; familiarity with government rules, procurement procedures and legal matters, including labour laws, is desirable.
